## §5.1.1–5.1.2: The *Hypersyntrix* ($\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}$) & Multi-Scale Encapsulation {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-d">MULTI-SCALE TRANSCENDENCE &amp; STRATUM D (SM, PP. 80–88, EQS. 20, 20a, 20b)</div>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="48%"}
### Crossing the Scale Threshold: *Hyperkategorien*
* Chapters 1–4 traced base-level Syntrices ($\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 0}{\mathbf{M}} \equiv \mathbf{y}\widetilde{\mathbf{a}}$), but nature and cognition are **irreducibly multi-scale**: an entire network of lower-level systems becomes a single elementary building block at the next scale of organization.
* In §5.1 (SM, p. 81), Heim constructs the **Metroplex ersten Grades**—the **Hypersyntrix ($\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}$)**:
$$
\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \;\equiv\; \big\langle\langle \underline{\mathrm{F}},\, \widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \rangle \underline{\mathrm{r}} \big\rangle \quad \lor \quad \widetilde{\mathrm{a}}| \;\equiv\; (\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}_i)_N \tag{SM-20}
$$

::: {.thm-box .fragment}
**The Higher-Order Triad & Corporate Pairings (SM Eqs. 20a, 20b):**
1. **Hypermetrophor (${}^1\mathbf{w}\widetilde{\mathbf{a}} \equiv (\mathbf{y}\widetilde{\mathbf{a}}_i)_N$):** Encapsulates $N$ complete base Syntrices from $T0$ as 0-dimensional objects.
2. **Metroplexsynkolator (${}^1\mathfrak{f} \equiv S(2)$):** Second-order Syntrixfunktor of valency $r$ correlating entire Syntrixfelder.
3. **Concentric (SM-20a) & Excentric (SM-20b) Pairings:**
$$
\overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}^{(l)} \left\{ \begin{smallmatrix} K_s & C_s \\ K_m & C_m \end{smallmatrix} \right\}^{(m)} \overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{b}},\; \overline{||},\; \overset{\scriptscriptstyle 1}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{c}} \tag{SM-20b}
$$
terminating at the **Nullmetroplex 1. Ordnung (${}^1\mathbf{M}_0$)**.
:::

:::

Heim's Hypersyntrix M^1 encapsulates N base Syntrices into its Hypermetrophor, replicating the entire operational grammar of Chapters 2 and 3 at a higher categorical type.
:::

## §5.1.3–5.1.5: Higher *Metroplexe* ($\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}$), Bridges & *Diabatik* {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-d">STRATUM D: METROPLEX RECURSION (SM EQS. 21–26), SYNTROKLINE BRÜCKEN &amp; DIABATIK</div>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="48%"}

::: {.thm-box}
**Recursive Grade-$n$ Hierarchy (SM Eqs. 21–24, p. 89):**
$$
\widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \equiv \overset{\scriptscriptstyle 0}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}, \qquad \overset{\scriptscriptstyle n+1}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \equiv \big\langle \overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{F}},\, \overset{\scriptscriptstyle\sim}{\mathbf{M}}{}^n\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}\,\underline{\mathrm{r}} \big\rangle, \qquad \overset{\scriptscriptstyle\sim}{\mathbf{M}}{}^n\widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \equiv \big(\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}_{(p)}\big)_{N_n} \tag{SM-21..24}
$$
* **Duale Endogene Tektonik (SM, p. 93):**
  1. **Graduelle Tektonik (Vertical):** Nested hierarchy across associated lower grades $0 \le k \le n-1$.
  2. **Syndromatische Tektonik (Horizontal):** Within-grade syndrome layers generated by ${}^k\mathfrak{f}$.
* **Kontraktion ($\kappa \colon \overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}} \to \overset{\scriptscriptstyle m}{\mathbf{M}}',\; m < n$):** Compresses complexity while preserving dominant invariants.
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Syntrokline Brücken (SM Eqs. 25, 25a) & *Metroplexdiabatik* (p. 103):**
$$
\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n+N}{\tilde{\alpha}} \;\equiv\; \underset{n}{\overset{n+N}{\mathrm{S}}}\, \overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}} \Big[ \big(\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n-1}{\widetilde{\Phi}}_{j(n)\gamma}\big) \big(\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n-1}{\widetilde{\mathrm{f}}}_{j(n)\gamma}, \underline{\mathrm{m}}\big) \big(\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\widetilde{\mathrm{f}}}_\gamma, \underline{\mathrm{r}}\big) \big(\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n+1}{\widetilde{\mathrm{f}}}, \mathrm{p}\big) \Big]_{\gamma=1}^{k_{(n)}} \tag{SM-25a}
$$
Totalities $T_n$ act as *Etagen* (floors); bridges ${}^{n+N}\alpha$ act as *Aufzüge* (elevators) enabling systemic coherence across scales.
:::

:::

Heim likens the Metroplextotalitäten T_n to floors of a building and Syntrokline Metroplexbrücken (SM Eq. 25a) to staircases or elevators connecting them. When a bridge couples inward at the Metrophor level (gamma = 0) and outward at a Syndrome level (gamma > 0), it forms a closed re-entrant feedback loop (syntrokline Rückkoppelung).
:::

## §5.2.1–5.2.3: The Ambient $(\infty, 1)$-Topos $\Xsyn$ & $\dCSeg(\Xsyn)$ {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-a">STRATUM A: GROTHENDIECK UNIVERSES (DEF. 5.1, FIG. 5.2) &amp; DENDROIDAL SEGAL SPACES (DEF. 5.2, PROP. 5.3)</div>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="48%"}

::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 5.1: Ambient $(\infty, 1)$-Topos $\Xsyn$ & Universe Safety**
Fix Grothendieck universes $\mathcal{U}_0 \in \mathcal{U}_1 \in \mathcal{U}_2$ and $\mathcal{S} \coloneqq \mathcal{S}_{\mathcal{U}_0}$. Instead of proliferating sites at every grade, all Metroplexe inhabit a single $\mathcal{U}_0$-presentable $(\infty, 1)$-topos (Lurie 2009):
$$
\Xsyn \;\coloneqq\; \mathbf{Sh}_\infty\big(\Ctx, \Jsyn\big) \;\coloneqq\; L_{\Jsyn}\!\Big(\operatorname{Fun}\big((\Ctx)^{\mathrm{op}}, \mathcal{S}\big)\Big)
$$
Every internal Metroplex $\mathbf{M}^n$ is $\mathcal{U}_0$-small inside $\Xsyn$, while $\Met_n(\Xsyn) \in \mathcal{U}_1$ and external functor slices reside in $\mathcal{U}_2$ (Fig. 5.2).
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Definition 5.2 & Proposition 5.3: Dendroidal Complete Segal Spaces**
Over the Moerdijk–Weiss tree category $\mathbf{\Omega}$ ($i \colon \mathbf{\Delta} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{\Omega}$), $\Met_1(\Xsyn) \coloneqq \dCSeg(\Xsyn) \subset \operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf{\Omega}^{\mathrm{op}}, \Xsyn)$ satisfies:

1. **Dendroidal Segal Grafting Equivalence:** For binary grafting $T = C_2^{(v)} \circ_e C_2^{(u)}$ along inner edge $\eta_e$:
$$
X(T) \;\xrightarrow{\;\sim\;}\; X(C_2^{(v)}) \mathop{\times}\limits^{\mathrm{h}}_{X(\eta_e)} X(C_2^{(u)})
$$
2. **Rezk Completeness:** $(i^*X)_0 \xrightarrow{\sim} (i^*X)_{\mathrm{hoequiv}} \subset (i^*X)_1$.
:::

:::

::::

::: {.notes}
Why formulate Metroplextheorie inside a single ambient (infinity,1)-topos X_syn rather than building a new Grothendieck site at every grade? Because iterating Site_{n+1} = Sh(Site_n) explodes set-theoretic universes at every step! Inside X_syn, higher multi-ary operadic categories live as U_0-small Dendroidal Complete Segal Spaces over the Moerdijk-Weiss tree category Omega.
:::

## §5.3.1–5.3.3: Transcendence Tower, Bridges & Postnikov $\tau_{\le m}$ {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: BRIDGE ADJUNCTIONS (PROP. 5.8) &amp; HOMOTOPY CONTRACTION (DEF. 5.9, FIGS. 5.1, 5.3, 5.4)</div>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="48%"}

::: {.thm-box}
**Defs. 5.5–5.7 & Proposition 5.8: Syntroclinic Bridge Adjunction**
* For $n \ge 1$, the Hypermetrophor is a simplicial diagram $H_n \colon \mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}} \to \Met_{n-1}(\Xsyn)$ with colimit $\HypMet_n \coloneqq \colim_{\mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}}}(U_{n-1}^{\Met} \circ H_n)$ generating $\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}\mathcal{S} \coloneqq \Free_{\On}(\HypMet_n)$.
* The **Syntroclinic Bridge** is the left adjoint extension-of-scalars functor:
$$
B_{n, n+N} \coloneqq (\phi_{n, n+N})_! \;\dashv\; (\phi_{n, n+N})^* =: R_{n+N, n}
$$
$B_{n, n+N}|_{\mathcal{I}_n}$ is **fully faithful** iff the unit $\eta_X \colon X \xrightarrow{\sim} R_{n+N, n}(B_{n, n+N}(X))$ is an equivalence!
:::

:::

::: {#coh-pane-1 .syn-tab-pane .active}
**1. Homological Banach Realization Functor $\RBan$ (Def. 5.12)**
Via free $\mathbb{R}$-linearization $\mathbb{R}[-] \colon \mathcal{S} \to s\mathbf{Vect}_{\mathbb{R}}$ and the Dold–Kan normalized chain equivalence $N_\bullet \colon s\mathbf{Vect}_{\mathbb{R}} \xrightarrow{\sim} \mathbf{Ch}_{\ge 0}(\mathbf{Vect}_{\mathbb{R}})$:
$$
\RBan(X) \;\coloneqq\; \bigoplus_{k=0}^\infty H_k\!\Big( N_\bullet\big(\mathbb{R}[\Gamma(X)]\big) \Big)_{\ell^1} \;\in\; \operatorname{Obj}(\FinBan)
$$
Degree $k=0$ recovers connected components $\mathbb{R}[\pi_0(\Gamma(X))]$, while $k \ge 1$ preserves higher homotopy invariants, yielding $\Tect_{\mathbf{Ban}}(\mathcal{S}) \coloneqq \RBan \circ \Tect(\mathcal{S})$.
:::

::: {#coh-pane-2 .syn-tab-pane}
**2. Lawvere–Schreiber Cohesive $(\infty, 1)$-Topos Quadruple (Def. 5.14)**
Extending global sections $\Gamma \colon \Xsyn \to \mathcal{S}$ to an adjoint quadruple where $\Disc$ preserves finite products and $\Pi(X \times Y) \simeq \Pi(X) \times \Pi(Y)$:
$$
\Pi \;\dashv\; \Disc \;\dashv\; \Gamma \;\dashv\; \Codisc \qquad \left(\Xsyn \underset{\Disc,\, \Codisc}{\overset{\Pi,\, \Gamma}{\rightleftarrows}} \mathcal{S}\right)
$$
:::

::: {#coh-pane-3 .syn-tab-pane}
**3. Internal Shape Modality $\int \coloneqq \Disc \circ \Pi$ (Smooth *Äondyne*)**
For any Metroplex $\mathcal{S} \in \Xsyn$, the left-most internal modality $\int(\mathcal{S})$ contracts smooth parameter paths to extract the **fundamental path-homotopy type**—formalizing Heim's continuously parameterized *Äondyne*!
:::

::: {#coh-pane-4 .syn-tab-pane}
**4. Flat ($\flat \coloneqq \Disc \circ \Gamma$) & Sharp ($\sharp \coloneqq \Codisc \circ \Gamma$) Modalities**
$$
\int \;\dashv\; \flat \;\dashv\; \sharp \;\colon\; \Xsyn \longrightarrow \Xsyn, \qquad \flat(\mathcal{S}) \xrightarrow{\;\epsilon_\flat\;} \mathcal{S} \xrightarrow{\;\eta_\sharp\;} \sharp(\mathcal{S})
$$
$\flat(\mathcal{S})$ extracts the underlying **discrete combinatorial skeleton** (*Diskreter Enyphanmetroplex*), while $\sharp(\mathcal{S})$ embeds into the codiscrete geometric envelope!
:::

:::

::: {.thm-box .fragment}
**Theorem 5.13 (2-Fold Segal Realization):**
$$
\big|\Tect(\mathcal{S})\big|_{\mathbf{\Delta}} \;\coloneqq\; \colim_{\mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}}}\big(\operatorname{diag}^* \Tect(\mathcal{S})\big) \;\simeq\; \colim_{\mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}} \times \mathbf{\Delta}^{\mathrm{op}}} \Tect(\mathcal{S})_{p,q}
$$
:::

:::

::::

::: {.notes}
Section 5.3.4 unifies vertical Graduelle Tektonik and horizontal Syndromatische Tektonik via the diagonal geometric realization of a bisimplicial object Tect(S). Section 5.3.5 equips X_syn with Lawvere-Schreiber cohesion (Shape int, Flat flat, Sharp sharp), uniting discrete combinatorial Enyphanmetroplexe with continuous Aeondynen.
:::

namespace Syntrometrie.StratumA.Metroplex

structure EndogenousAdmissible (n p q : ℕ) : Prop where

  pos_shift   : 0 < q

/-- Syntroclinic bridge hom-set adjunction equivalence (Def. 5.7, Prop. 5.8) -/
def syntroclinicHomEquiv {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {B : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} (adj : B ⊣ R) (X : C) (Y : D) :
    (B.obj X ⟶ Y) ≃ (X ⟶ R.obj Y) :=
  adj.homEquiv X Y

end Syntrometrie.StratumA.Metroplex</code></pre>

  } else {
    svg.innerHTML = `
      <rect x="45" y="32" width="125" height="55" rx="6" fill="#0f1b3d" stroke="#4169E1" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="107" y="56" fill="#82aaff" font-size="10.5" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">(w ∘₁ v) ∘₁ u</text>
      <text x="107" y="74" fill="#cbd5e1" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Left Graft Order</text>
      <path d="M 175,58 L 245,58" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="3"/>
      <text x="210" y="48" fill="#FFD700" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">≃ X(T₃)</text>
      <rect x="250" y="32" width="125" height="55" rx="6" fill="#151c2c" stroke="#20B2AA" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="312" y="56" fill="#5eead4" font-size="10.5" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">w ∘₁ (v ∘₂ u)</text>
      <text x="312" y="74" fill="#cbd5e1" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Right Graft Order</text>
    `;
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#9370DB";
    box.innerHTML = `<b>3. Coherent Associativity Homotopy:</b> Applying the dendroidal Segal equivalence to a 3-vertex tree T₃ identifies both iterated composites with X(T₃), supplying the canonical associativity homotopy!`;
  }
};

// WIDGET 4: §5.3.3 Postnikov Homotopy Contraction
window.updatePostnikov = function() {
  const elM = document.getElementById('post-m');
  if (!elM) return;
  let m = parseInt(elM.value);
  let lbl = document.getElementById('post-m-val');
  let path = document.getElementById('post-path');
  let pt0 = document.getElementById('post-pt0');
  let box = document.getElementById('post-readout');

  if (m === 0) {
    lbl.innerText = "m = 0";
    path.setAttribute('d', '');
    pt0.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>0-Truncation τ_{≤0} X ≃ π₀(X) (Set Collapse, §5.5.2):</b></span><br>` +
      `All higher homotopy groups vanish (π_{k≥1} = 0). Collapses the homotopy type to its discrete sheaf of connected components!`;
  } else {
    pt0.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    lbl.innerText = (m === 3) ? "m = ∞" : `m = ${m}`;
    let amp = (m === 1) ? 0.0 : (m === 2 ? 7.5 : 18.0);
    let freq = (m === 2) ? 6 : 14;
    let pts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 120; i++) {
      let t = (i / 120.0) * 2.0 * Math.PI;
      let rx = 90 + amp * Math.sin(freq * t);
      let ry = 50 + amp * Math.cos(freq * t);
      let x = 210 + rx * Math.cos(t);
      let y = 72 + ry * Math.sin(t);
      pts.push((i === 0 ? "M " : "L ") + x.toFixed(1) + "," + y.toFixed(1));
    }
    pts.push("Z");
    path.setAttribute('d', pts.join(" "));
    path.setAttribute('stroke', m === 1 ? "#20B2AA" : (m === 2 ? "#FFA500" : "#DC143C"));

    if (m === 1) {
      box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
      box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#20B2AA;"><b>1-Truncation τ_{≤1} X (Fundamental Groupoid):</b></span><br>` +
        `Preserves π₀(X) and fundamental group loops π₁(X), while extinguishing all higher homotopy noise (π_{k≥2} = 0)!`;
    } else if (m === 2) {
      box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFA500";
      box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFA500;"><b>2-Truncation τ_{≤2} X (2-Type Approximation):</b></span><br>` +
        `Retains π₀, π₁, and 2-dimensional surface homotopy π₂(X); filters out all k ≥ 3 fluctuations.`;
    } else {
      box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
      box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>Untruncated Object X ∈ X_syn (Full ∞-Groupoid):</b></span><br>` +
        `Contains arbitrarily high microscopic homotopy fluctuations π_k(X) across all degrees k ≥ 1.`;
    }
  }
};

// WIDGET 5: §5.3.4 Bisimplicial Tectonic Grid
window.setTectMode = function(mode) {
  let svg = document.getElementById('tect-svg');
  let box = document.getElementById('tect-readout');
  if (!svg || !box) return;
  let html = '';

  for (let p = 0; p < 4; p++) {
    for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
      let x = 75 + p * 90;
      let y = 142 - q * 38;
      if (p < 3) {
        let col = (mode === 'syn') ? '#4169E1' : '#2d3748';
        let w = (mode === 'syn') ? 3.2 : 1.5;
        html += `<line x1="${x}" y1="${y}" x2="${x+90}" y2="${y}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="${w}"/>`;
      }
      if (q < 3) {
        let col = (mode === 'grad') ? '#20B2AA' : '#2d3748';
        let w = (mode === 'grad') ? 3.2 : 1.5;
        html += `<line x1="${x}" y1="${y}" x2="${x}" y2="${y-38}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="${w}"/>`;
      }
    }
  }

  if (mode === 'diag') {
    html += `<line x1="75" y1="142" x2="345" y2="28" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>`;
  }

  for (let p = 0; p < 4; p++) {
    for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
      let x = 75 + p * 90;
      let y = 142 - q * 38;
      let isDiag = (p === q);
      let fill = '#1e293b';
      let stroke = '#4169E1';
      let r = 12;
      if (mode === 'diag' && isDiag) { fill = '#FFD700'; stroke = '#fff'; r = 15; }
      else if (mode === 'syn') { fill = '#4169E1'; stroke = '#fff'; }
      else if (mode === 'grad') { fill = '#20B2AA'; stroke = '#fff'; }

      let txtCol = (mode === 'diag' && isDiag) ? '#000' : '#fff';
      html += `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${r}" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
      html += `<text x="${x}" y="${y+3.5}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${txtCol}" font-size="9.5" font-weight="bold">S_${p},${q}</text>`;
    }
  }

  svg.innerHTML = html;
  if (mode === 'diag') {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>Diagonal Realization |Tect(S)|_Δ (Thm. 5.13):</b></span> colim_{Δ^op}(diag* Tect(S)) ≃ colim_{Δ^op × Δ^op} S_{p,q} unifies vertical and horizontal tectonics!`;
  } else if (mode === 'syn') {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#4169E1";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#82aaff;"><b>Horizontal Axis Syn_• (d_i^h):</b></span> Syndromatische Tektonik—within-grade syndrome layers generated by operadic composition ^k f.`;
  } else {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#5eead4;"><b>Vertical Axis Gr_• (d_j^v):</b></span> Graduelle Tektonik—nested compositional filtration across associated lower Metroplex grades 0 ≤ p ≤ n-1.`;
  }
};

// WIDGET 6: §5.3.4–5.3.5 Cohesion & Dold-Kan Tab Switcher
window.showCohesionTab = function(idx, btnEl) {
  for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
    const p = document.getElementById('coh-pane-' + i);
    if (p) p.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
  }
  if (btnEl && btnEl.parentElement) {
    Array.from(btnEl.parentElement.children).forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btnEl.classList.add('active');
  }
  if (window.MathJax && window.MathJax.typesetPromise) {
    window.MathJax.typesetPromise().catch(() => {});
  }
};

// WIDGET 7: §5.3.5 Tectonic Spectral Sequence E^r_{p,q}
window.setSpecPage = function(r) {
  let d2 = document.getElementById('ss-d2');
  let d3 = document.getElementById('ss-d3');
  let box = document.getElementById('ss-readout');
  if (!d2 || !d3 || !box) return;

  if (r === 2) {
    d2.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    d3.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>E²-Page Active (d² : E²_{p,q} → E²_{p-2, q+1} ≠ 0):</b></span> First-order <b>Metroplexdiabatik</b>—a grade-p structure injects a non-trivial boundary 2 grades down into syndrome level q + 1!`;
  } else if (r === 3) {
    d2.setAttribute('opacity', '0.2');
    d3.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>E³-Page Active (d³ : E³_{3,0} → E³_{0,2} ≠ 0):</b></span> Deep cross-scale <b>Metroplexdiabatik</b>—transgressing 3 vertical Metroplex grades into syndrome level q + 2!`;
  } else {
    d2.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    d3.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#20B2AA;"><b>Adiabatic Decoupled Limit (d^r ≡ 0 for all r ≥ 2):</b></span> Spectral sequence degenerates at E² = E^∞; scales evolve without cross-grade diabatic feedback.`;
  }
};

// WIDGET 8: §5.3.7 Endogenous Grade-Admissibility (SM Eq. 26)
window.updateENLab = function() {
  const elN = document.getElementById('en-n');
  if (!elN) return;
  let n = parseInt(elN.value);
  let p = parseInt(document.getElementById('en-p').value);
  let q = parseInt(document.getElementById('en-q').value);
  document.getElementById('en-n-val').innerText = n;
  document.getElementById('en-p-val').innerText = p;
  document.getElementById('en-q-val').innerText = q;

  let sum = p + q;
  let box = document.getElementById('en-readout');

  if (q <= 0) {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>✗ VIOLATES POSITIVITY (q = ${q} ≤ 0):</b></span> SM Eq. 26 and Lean 4 <code>pos_shift : 0 &lt; q</code> require strictly positive shift grade q &gt; 0!`;
  } else if (sum > n) {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>✗ VIOLATES GRADE BOUND (p + q = ${sum} &gt; n = ${n}):</b></span> Exceeds ambient Metroplex grade n; triggers recursive grade runaway!`;
  } else if (sum === n) {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>✓ EXACT ENDOGENOUS SYNTHESIS (p + q = ${sum} = n, q = ${q} &gt; 0):</b></span><br>` +
      `Activates <b>SynEN_{${p},${q}}^{${n}} : Met_${p} × Met_${q} → Met_${n}</b> (and <b>AbsEN_${n}^{${sum}}</b>)!`;
  } else {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#20B2AA;"><b>✓ ADMISSIBLE TECTONIC ABSORPTION (p + q = ${sum} &lt; n = ${n}, q = ${q} &gt; 0):</b></span><br>` +
      `Satisfies Lean 4 <code>EndogenousAdmissible ${n} ${p} ${q}</code>; activates <b>AbsEN_${n}^{${sum}} : Met_${n} × Met_${sum} → Met_${n}</b>!`;
  }
};

function ensureVideosPlaying() {
  document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(v => {
    v.muted = true;
    v.playsInline = true;
    if (v.paused) v.play().catch(() => {});
  });
}

function initAllCh5Widgets() {
  window.updateEncapsulationLab();
  window.setDiabatikMode('loop');
  window.setDendroidalStep(1);
  window.updatePostnikov();
  window.setTectMode('diag');
  window.setSpecPage(2);
  window.updateENLab();
  ensureVideosPlaying();

  document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], select, button').forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    input.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    input.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => e.stopPropagation(), {passive: true});
  });

  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.target.tagName === 'VIDEO') {
          entry.target.muted = true;
          entry.target.play().catch(() => {});
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.15 });
    document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(v => obs.observe(v));
  }
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initAllCh5Widgets);
} else {
  initAllCh5Widgets();
}

window.addEventListener('load', initAllCh5Widgets);
if (window.Reveal) {
  window.Reveal.on('ready', initAllCh5Widgets);
  window.Reveal.on('slidechanged', initAllCh5Widgets);
}
</script>
